parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace, which is the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones grouping them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers. Since a closure can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, I need to manage this shared airspace information, which comes from the authorities and is the same for everyone.
